issues: Treats the two abstract-level model publications (S2, S3) as full-text inspected and reports full-text-only metrics despite the brief requiring them to remain abstract-level evidence.

Internal contradiction: the English appraisal says all three supplied publications were read at full text, while the Chinese summary says the model references are recorded and appraised at abstract level and no abstract is called full text.
Full citations, DOIs, author names, and detailed full-text values for S2/S3 are asserted without being bonded to the supplied abstract sources, risking invented data.
judge.rationale: The delivery is thorough and answers the scoping question with appropriate symmetric treatment of cohort overlap and a non-clinical handling rule. However, it mishandles access levels: S2 and S3 were supplied as abstracts and had to remain abstract-level evidence, but the delivery labels them full-text inspected and uses full-text-only content, creating an internal contradiction and undermining source bonding.
